author: Netsi
notes: The astronomy is a TypeScript port of SunCalc v2.0.2 (index.js), implementing Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' ch. 15 and 25. Numerics are unchanged from upstream and cross-checked against it across 78 phase times at 8 locations including polar cases; the largest deviation was sub-second and came from trimming milliseconds in the ISO output. The contract around the maths — validated input, ISO 8601 rendering, IANA time zones and explicit polar day/night flags — is new. Upstream's BSD-2-Clause notice is retained verbatim in license/LICENSE as redistribution requires.
